design.banding: every band table in this file is by SONGS per label; the components-per-label banding is gated and never reported, because the repo calls two different bands '20-49'

estimands.component_weighted: sum(rr w) / sum(w); the estimand of every paired_group_bootstrap interval here and of the published by_band.*.mrr numbers
estimands.label_macro: the component-weighted mean within a label, then the plain mean over the labels present in the mask
estimands.query_weighted: mean of 1/rank over queries; the estimand of the published systems.* MRRs and of this file's gate

design.folds: identity_probe_v2 folds and transforms; profiles leave-group-out over all songs; the pooled s^2 from the training folds, as published
design.not_built: no scorer is built on r_hat^2 here, only its degeneracy rate recorded; no znorm arm, no floor-removed arm (the floor's effect is read from the exact factor-of-two identity and the floored stratum instead of from a scorer whose divisor would be clamped near zero), and no verdict on the decomposition

reading_rules.R1_pooling: defensible in a space if both quartiles of s2_l / s2_pooled lie inside [0.9, 1.1]; if not, the space's published noise_corrected column is one particular per-label reweighting, not the size effect removed
reading_rules.R2_weight_term: the published 1/G_l is adequate if the third quartile of G_l/K_l is below 1.01 and the whole interval of (weight-aware - published) MRR lies inside +/-0.005
reading_rules.R3_floor: the floor is the mechanism of the published change if at least 95% of floored pairs lie in columns floored for every query and the floored stratum's interval clears the margin in the same direction as the overall change; a gain is named only where the whole interval lies above +0.005 and a cost only where it lies below -0.005
reading_rules.R4_degeneracy: a number recorded for calibrated_profile_scorer_v3, not a test

scorers.noise_corrected: the published scorer: (dots/counts) / sqrt(max(m2 - s2/counts, 0.25 m2))
scorers.noise_corrected_weight_aware: the same with s2 K(q,l)/counts^2 subtracted instead of s2/counts
scorers.prototype: the protocol: cosine with the normalised leave-group-out profile

tolerances.note: no tolerance is tighter than the guarantee of the code that produced the number; the floor-hit counts are reported, never gated, because nothing guarantees them and question 3 is asked to correct them

identity_is_algebraic.gap_closed_form: gap_l = [K_l(nu - 1) + sum_c (1 - 1/k_c)(chat_c - C_bar_l)] / (G_l(G_l - 1)), with nu the component-weighted mean squared row norm; a singleton component contributes exactly zero because 1 - 1/k_c = 0
identity_is_algebraic.reading: the bound is an order of magnitude inside any margin a reader would declare, and it is identically zero for every label whose leakage groups each hold one song, so a test of the decomposition could not have failed; the four questions below are the empirical ones
identity_is_algebraic.statement: the decomposition E||m_l||^2 = r_l^2 + s^2 W_l is an algebraic identity given the definitions, not a hypothesis, so this file does not test it and reports no verdict on it

50-up.note: fewer than 5 labels: median and quantiles suppressed

identity_is_algebraic.upper_bound_definition: with unit rows, |gap_l| <= 2 (G_l - K_l) / (G_l (G_l - 1)), since the cosines of unit vectors differ by at most 2

privacy: aggregate only: quantiles, band tables and counts over labels and query-label pairs; no song id, label name, artist, lyric text or vector, no per-label array, and no median or quantiles for a band holding fewer than 5 labels
question: the profile-norm decomposition is an algebraic identity, so what is uncertain in the published noise-corrected scorer is elsewhere: is one pooled s^2 per (space, fold) defensible, is W = 1/G_l right, what does the floor do, and how often is the component-level U-statistic degenerate

chars_raw.floor: the floor is NOT established as the mechanism of the published change in chars_raw: 0.9438 of fold 0's floored pairs lie in the 17 columns floored for every query, of which 12 of the 19 labels in the 5-9 band; noise_corrected minus prototype overall is a gain of +0.0223 [+0.0150, +0.0291], component-weighted; and among queries whose own label was floored is a gain of +0.2651 [+0.2176, +0.3136], component-weighted
chars_raw.pooling: pooling one s^2 across labels is DEFENSIBLE in chars_raw: the interquartile ratio of a label's own s^2 to the pooled one is [0.993, 1.025], inside the declared [0.9, 1.1]
chars_raw.weight_term: the published W = 1/G_l is INADEQUATE in chars_raw: the third quartile of G_l/K_l is 1.0173 against the declared 1.01, and replacing it with the weight-aware term is inside the 0.005 margin (+0.0031 [+0.0006, +0.0056], component-weighted), so neither a gain nor a cost is claimed
